profile.headline: Lead Backend Developer at Avenue Z
profile.summary:
I'm a U.S. Army veteran and software engineer. After a decade in the trades — first as a helicopter repairer in the Army, then as an automotive technician — I taught myself to code, then formalized it through a full-stack program, and I've spent the last 4+ years shipping production software.

Today I'm a Shopify developer at Avenue Z (a Shopify Premier Partner), where I've grown well beyond the storefront. Over ~2 years I've shipped 100+ merged pull requests across roughly 10 production e-commerce sites, and moved into backend and integrations work: services in Rust, Go, and Node.js, webhook pipelines with HMAC verification, REST and GraphQL APIs, the Shopify Admin API, and CRM integrations running on Azure Functions. A recent project I'm proud of is a multi-service B2B order system — a Rust middleware, a Node.js order-splitter, and a Shopify app — that lets a company place one order that automatically splits into a separate order per recipient.

How I work: I read the system before I change it, keep changes small and low-risk, and verify against real data instead of assumptions. That mindset came from the trades, where a missed detail has real consequences.

I'm bilingual (English/Spanish) and have shipped Spanish-language features in production. I also spent 4+ years building a freelance practice on Upwork, which taught me to scope, communicate, and deliver without hand-holding.

Always happy to talk with anyone building serious systems and finding real solutions.
